children: Yields on two-year U.K. government bonds, or gilts, climb to a two-week high as oil prices advance. Markets have raised their expectations of the Bank of England raising interest rates in December as high energy prices increase inflation risk. Brent crude rises 3.2% to $94.4 a barrel. Two-year gilt yields hit 4.925%, the highest level since Oct. 29, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
